_strawberry.hill_: The sergeant gave Jakub "Hollow" Hill a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 4 or any other.
Jakub "Hollow" Hill tipped water from a boot and a small beetle climbed out. At least one passenger had enjoyed the crossing.

Henrik Hunted had Jakub "Hollow" Hill of the Hegemony in the sights at the Hanging Bridge for a long second. Jakub "Hollow" Hill was lighting a pipe. Henrik Hunted let the match burn all the way down. The Hegemony took Hill 304, and the orders at R-F21 changed before the cheering ended. Jakub "Hollow" Hill shouldered another load.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F21 and grazed Jakub "Hollow" Hill's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Emil "Smokes" Pineapplejam of the Concord (@pineapplejamming).

Jakub "Hollow" Hill was hit through the chest at R-F21. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Emil "Smokes" Pineapplejam of the Concord (@pineapplejamming). A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Jakub "Hollow" Hill was carried in at last. Jakub "Hollow" Hill slipped away in the night. The orderly who sat with him says he was not afraid.
A letter came with Jonas Hill: "I am Jakub "Hollow" Hill's cousin. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.

The whole squad at R-F21 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Jonas Hill's bullet that found Gustav Scottjseale, grazed. A bullet hit Jonas Hill in the neck at R-F21. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Konrad Nsrr of the Concord (@nsrr_007). Jonas Hill was carried into the hospital dugout feet first, because that was the only way the stretcher fit through the door. Jonas Hill opened his eyes today and asked for water. At R-F21 they cheered when the news came up the line.
Jonas Hill spent the day in bed trading cigarettes for stories with the man in the next bed. He came out ahead.

The medical officer cleared Jonas Hill for duty. At R-F21, someone quietly moved a pack off his usual seat. Victory at Blackwater Canal. Jonas Hill let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Jonas Hill fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Viktor "Rabbit" Daxmunro was badly wounded, and that rifle did not fire again tonight. A trench mortar bomb landed in the next section of trench. The blast caught Jonas Hill at R-F21 and the bearers came at a run. Jonas Hill got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 271. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Jonas Hill did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Clean sheets, a lamp, and a surgeon. Jonas Hill was admitted to the hospital dugout and finally let go of his rifle.
Jonas Hill watched a fly cross the ceiling of the ward for an hour. It was the most exciting thing that happened, and he was glad of it.
The medics would not give up on Jonas Hill. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to R-F21 today.
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Jonas Hill lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
Jonas Hill fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Ulrich Daxmunro was gravely wounded.
Jonas Hill fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Ulrich "Mole" Marks, gravely wounded.
Fresh from training, Jonas still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Leopold "Ash" Media, grazed.
addddamsss: The sergeant gave Henrik Addddamsss a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Henrik Addddamsss heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Henrik Addddamsss saved the last of the sugar for Tobias "Smokes" Chris's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Smokes's birthday. It was a good day anyway. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Henrik Addddamsss is number 928. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Henrik Addddamsss wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Henrik Addddamsss opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first.
Henrik Addddamsss wrote a song about the Drowned Farm. Lucien "Tin" Wtm wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third.

Henrik Addddamsss was hit in the forearm at S-R14. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Zeno Ramsey of the Hegemony (@colt.d.ramsey).
Henrik Addddamsss was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at S-R14. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Jonas Nicolassuess of the Hegemony (@nicolassuess).

Henrik Addddamsss's bandage soaked through twice in one night. The medic called the bearers before morning. Henrik Addddamsss reached the hospital dugout after a long wait. The surgeon took one look at the wound and went to wash up.
Henrik Addddamsss opened his eyes today and asked for water. At S-R14 they cheered when the news came up the line.
Henrik returned from hospital and found a new face beside the bunk. The old argument about shelf space resumed immediately.
akauncletom: Edmund "Parson" Akauncletom came up on Day 11 carrying news from Ashford Vale. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into V-F7. Edmund "Parson" Akauncletom has learned to walk bent double.
Edmund "Parson" Akauncletom took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for.
Edmund "Parson" Akauncletom tested the telephone and heard someone at headquarters chewing. The line was declared perfectly clear.
Edmund "Parson" Akauncletom went out with the wiring party at V-F7. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit.

Edmund "Parson" Akauncletom lent Florian Dukey a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'. A letter from home found Edmund "Parson" Akauncletom before the night shift. Edmund "Parson" Akauncletom folded it small and kept it close. The transfer made Edmund "Parson" Akauncletom a rifleman. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

Edmund "Parson" Akauncletom jumped into the Hegemony trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Hugo Luckystrike. The Hegemony medics will be busy. (@luckystrike_148) In the dark of the Hegemony trench Edmund "Parson" Akauncletom hit Albin "Mole" Sladek with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@s_sladek) Edmund "Parson" Akauncletom came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. Edmund "Parson" Akauncletom got a letter with a pressed leaf from the tree by the front door at home.

Edmund "Parson" Akauncletom walked back up the communication trench to V-F7, slower than before, but on his own feet. A short letter reached Edmund "Parson" Akauncletom: everyone is well, the dog misses you. Edmund "Parson" Akauncletom read the part about the dog twice.

Edmund tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread. Edmund got a letter in a language only he and his family speak. Nobody else in the squad could read a word, and Edmund liked it that way.
alessiosantori: Ulrich Alessiosanto reached R-C9 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Ulrich Alessiosanto landed next to Walter "Crow" Acakostic in the Hegemony trench. Only Ulrich Alessiosanto climbed back out. (@acakostic11) Ulrich Alessiosanto counted the steps of the Hegemony sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal never saw the shovel coming. (@hodnepijumaloctu) Ulrich Alessiosanto took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at R-C9, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Cyril "Crow" Trevor of the Hegemony (@trevor.f78). The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Ulrich Alessiosanto read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

A medic brought Ulrich Alessiosanto half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real. The clerk counted the names twice. Ulrich Alessiosanto is number 617 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Ulrich Alessiosanto watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
No bed, no surgeon, just a medic with a kit and a lot of patience. Ulrich Alessiosanto recovered anyway and is back at R-C9.
Ulrich Alessiosanto (Concord) and Benedikt Finland (Hegemony) were sent out to cut the other side's wire at Saint-Ash crossroads on the same night. They met in the middle and agreed to go home.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet clipped Ulrich Alessiosanto's helmet at R-C9 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low.
Three days with a bandage, and Ulrich Alessiosanto is back at R-C9. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.

The raid hit the Hegemony line at the darkest hour. Ulrich Alessiosanto fought Oskar "Whistle" Jozifanderso in a trench no wider than a door. Ulrich Alessiosanto came home with Oskar "Whistle" Jozifanderso's cap badge. (@jozifanderson) Ulrich Alessiosanto crawled through a gap in the Hegemony wire and slid into their trench. Rafael Jacob reached for a rifle. Ulrich Alessiosanto was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@miguell.jacob)
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Ulrich Alessiosanto aimed a step ahead and fired: Marek Jozifanderso, gravely wounded.
A man asked Ulrich to describe Marrow Fen without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
frogman.clan: The quartermaster asked Quentin "Shadow" Clan to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Quentin "Shadow" Clan helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Quentin "Shadow" Clan had just lit a cigarette at S-R15 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Pavel Moovin of the Concord (@da_moovin). The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Quentin "Shadow" Clan helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

A bullet went through Quentin "Shadow" Clan's upper arm at S-R15 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Pavel Moovin of the Concord (@da_moovin). Quentin "Shadow" Clan was killed on watch at S-R15. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Pavel Moovin of the Concord (@da_moovin).
The House of Clan sent Benedikt Clan after Quentin "Shadow" Clan. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
The fog lifted at noon and Benedikt Clan saw the Hanging Bridge clearly for the first time. He wished it had stayed.
Benedikt Clan saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards.
Benedikt Clan was carrying water up to S-R15 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Benedikt Clan did not. Shot by Dietrich Fokai of the Concord (@tru_og_fokai).
Benedikt Clan asked the bearers for water and then for his mother. He died before either came.
Another member of the House of Clan reached the line: Wendel Clan. He asked where Benedikt Clan had slept, then chose a different corner.

Wendel Clan had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Lucien Gloose, grazed. Wendel Clan had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Norbert Seamus was gravely wounded.
In reserve, Wendel slept nine hours in a barn. He dreamt of nothing, which was the best part.
grouchyfish89541: Leopold Grouchyfish came up with a draft of replacements on Day 8. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
Leopold Grouchyfish of the Concord and Valentin Bladestalker of the Hegemony have carved their names into the same post in no man's land at Calvary Farm. It is getting crowded.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Leopold Grouchyfish watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Leopold Grouchyfish stacked spare duckboards beside the junction. Within an hour, the stack had become a bench, a table and an argument. The clerk counted the names twice. Leopold Grouchyfish is number 541 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Leopold Grouchyfish read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

A single shot from across the wire hit Leopold Grouchyfish in the thigh at S-S3. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Gideon "Crow" Colm of the Hegemony (@colm91019). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Leopold Grouchyfish fell at S-S3 and never moved again. Shot by Gideon "Crow" Colm of the Hegemony (@colm91019).
Konrad Grouchyfish came to the front because his uncle Leopold Grouchyfish never came home. He carries a lock of hair in a matchbox.
Konrad Grouchyfish followed a cough through the fog and found the ration party stuck at a junction. For once, a cough improved supper.

The barrage caught Konrad Grouchyfish in the open at S-S3. The medic tied two tourniquets and shouted for a bed. At S-S3 a shell hit the exact spot where Konrad Grouchyfish was standing. The trench wall there is gone, and so is Konrad Grouchyfish.
The papers connected Lucien "Smokes" Grouchyfish to Konrad Grouchyfish. The men took longer to learn Lucien "Smokes" Grouchyfish's own habits, but they made the effort.

Lucien "Smokes" Grouchyfish was carrying water up to S-S3 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Lucien "Smokes" Grouchyfish did not. Shot by Cyril Bmx of the Hegemony (@ian_bmx_51). Lucien "Smokes" Grouchyfish did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Lucien "Smokes" Grouchyfish fired back. Valentin "Shadow" Castlecrashe was grazed.
A medic brought Lucien "Smokes" Grouchyfish half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real.
The medics called Lucien "Smokes" Grouchyfish 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Lucien "Smokes" Grouchyfish is back on the line.
Lucien was hit in the forearm at S-S3. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Valentin Ryukov of the Hegemony (@ryukov46).
heyyybigmike: The draft reached S-C3 on Day 9. Jonas Heyyybigmike was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Jonas Heyyybigmike landed next to Leopold "Saint" Hop in the Concord trench. Only Jonas Heyyybigmike climbed back out. (@its.hop_) Jonas Heyyybigmike made it into the enemy trench and out again, but a machine gun swept no man's land on the way home. Jonas Heyyybigmike crawled the last yards. Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Jonas Heyyybigmike could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable. A letter from home reached Jonas Heyyybigmike before dusk. Jonas Heyyybigmike read it twice and slept a little easier.

A bullet struck Jonas Heyyybigmike below the ribs at S-C3. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Zeno Hop of the Concord (@its.hop_). Jonas Heyyybigmike looked over the parapet at S-C3 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Zeno Hop of the Concord (@its.hop_).

Gustav Heyyybigmike came to the front because his cousin Jonas Heyyybigmike never came home. He carries a bullet that missed him. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Gustav Heyyybigmike answered to number 870. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Gustav Heyyybigmike did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Gustav Heyyybigmike lay behind a dead tree trunk at S-C3 for six hours without moving. One shot at dusk. Bastian "Mud" Maann was grazed.
A dummy head on a stick drew the enemy's eye at S-C3. Gustav Heyyybigmike saw where the answering shot came from and fired back. Isidor Roryhacon was gravely wounded.
Gustav Heyyybigmike went out with the wiring party at S-C3. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit.

Gideon "Crow" Colm kept watch so that Gustav Heyyybigmike could sleep. Then Gustav kept watch so that Crow could. Neither slept. A letter from home reached Gustav Heyyybigmike before dusk. Gustav Heyyybigmike read it twice and slept a little easier.

Night raid. Gustav Heyyybigmike crossed no man's land, saw the enemy sentry too late to reach, and came back without a scratch. Next time, says Gustav Heyyybigmike. The letter for Gustav Heyyybigmike was mostly about the weather at home. Gustav Heyyybigmike read that part twice too.
Gustav Heyyybigmike took the shot at four hundred yards. The spotter whispered the result: Silas Kstoner, badly wounded.
Gustav climbed out before dawn and crawled to a new position. Behind a stump, in the dark, he waited for the light.
loganhawkins6464: The draft reached V-F12 on Day 12. Zeno Loganhawkins was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
The patrol came back one man at a time. Zeno Loganhawkins held the gap open and counted until the corporal said that was everyone.
Zeno Loganhawkins crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at V-F12 holds again.
Otto Strawberrrry mended the hole in Zeno Loganhawkins's trousers with fishing line and a bent pin. Zeno says the patch is stronger than the trousers.
The last of the jam was shared by passing the tin around. Zeno Loganhawkins approved the method.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Zeno Loganhawkins read a theatre review while peeling supper.
Zeno washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation.
pyyro.2030: Oskar "Mud" Pyyro left a teacher who said he would amount to nothing behind in Port Abel and came up the line with a pressed cornflower. The men noticed at once that he collects shell fuses.
Oskar "Mud" Pyyro sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway.

A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Oskar "Mud" Pyyro's bunk. He has named it Napoleon. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Hill 304. Oskar "Mud" Pyyro folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Oskar "Mud" Pyyro raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F2. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Tobias "Smokes" Chris of the Concord (@mightbe_chris).
A bullet found Oskar "Mud" Pyyro at R-F2, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Otto Geronimoleys of the Concord (@geronimoleysen).
Oskar "Mud" Pyyro lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant.
Oskar "Mud" Pyyro spent a week on a stretcher in the corridor of the aid post. Today he stood up, held the wall, and walked out to R-F2.
The Concord raiders were in and out in two minutes. At R-F2 they left Oskar "Mud" Pyyro behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Rafael "Owl" Franz of the Concord (@frankly_franz).
Cyril Pyyro had heard about Oskar "Mud" Pyyro's courage. At R-F2, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

A bullet clipped Cyril Pyyro's helmet at R-F2 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Walter Fisher of the Concord (@gage_fisher01). Cyril Pyyro got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 291. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Cyril Pyyro helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Cyril Pyyro came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.

The men at R-F2 heard Cyril Pyyro call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Pavel "Ghost" Echoss of the Concord (@echoss_3). The bearers reached Cyril Pyyro at R-F2 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Pavel "Ghost" Echoss of the Concord (@echoss_3).
Clement Pyyro put a pressed cornflower beside the bunk. Someone who had known Cyril Pyyro helped clear the shelf without saying why.

A bullet struck Clement Pyyro below the ribs at R-F2. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Pavel "Ghost" Echoss of the Concord (@echoss_3). Clement Pyyro was killed at R-F2 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Pavel "Ghost" Echoss of the Concord (@echoss_3).
The House of Pyyro sent Rafael Pyyro after Clement Pyyro. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
Rafael Pyyro got a letter from Rosa. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.
A beetle crawled across Rafael Pyyro's sleeve during the long wait. He could do nothing about it without giving away the position.
A bullet hit the sandbag next to Rafael Pyyro's ear at R-F2 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Marek Lzed of the Concord (@lzed003).

Rafael was hit in the hip at R-F2. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Henrik Ami of the Concord (@ami_ne_dz13). Clean sheets, a lamp, and a surgeon. Rafael was admitted to the field hospital and finally let go of his rifle.
quinnhislop: Tobias Quinnhislop, a butcher's boy from Port Abel, was sent forward on Day 16 to fill a gap in N-F3. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Tobias Quinnhislop noticed regular flashes from a broken chimney. The position looks obvious enough to make him suspicious.
A clear shot from N-F3. Tobias badly wounded Jakub "Mud" Function and slid back down below the parapet.
sambennett520: Ulrich "Shadow" Sambennett came up the line with his brother's pocket watch and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Ulrich "Shadow" Sambennett wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Emil Painter of the Hegemony lost a cap on a night patrol near the Chalk Pits. Ulrich "Shadow" Sambennett of the Concord found it in the morning and now wears it on Sundays. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich "Shadow" Sambennett. Ulrich "Shadow" Sambennett read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
The corporal found out Ulrich "Shadow" Sambennett used to be a stonemason. Ulrich "Shadow" Sambennett has been doing two jobs ever since.
Ulrich "Shadow" Sambennett saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards.
Ulrich "Shadow" Sambennett kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it.
A bullet hit the sandbag beside Ulrich "Shadow" Sambennett. He ducked, and noticed his hands were shaking. He kept working anyway.
Ulrich "Shadow" Sambennett and Gideon Senpai sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
Ulrich found a patient asleep on a stretcher and stood guard over the stretcher until the surgeon came.
samhatespeace: The new stretcher bearer is Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac, once a ferryman from Belmonte. The corporal asked if a ferryman was any use in a trench. Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac said he would find out.
Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac, volunteer number 81, received the First Wave ribbon. The quartermaster pronounced the name wrong; he corrected it for the record.
Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac tried to describe the smell of Belmonte and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived.

During a lull at Sorrow Copse, Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac called across from the Concord line. Roland Monster answered from the Hegemony side with a convincing imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.
Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac held the mirror while Rafael "Button" Superfeisty shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.

Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F9. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Marek Ditrih of the Hegemony (@ditrih_88). Day 6. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. Mail came up the line with a letter for Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac. Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. After what happened at Saint-Ash crossroads, Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac asked to serve as a rifleman. Nobody argued.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac in the open at R-F9. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Marek Izu of the Hegemony (@arch_izu). Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac fired at a movement across the wire at R-F9. The man went down: Leopold Shadowizard, gravely wounded. Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac looked over the parapet at R-F9 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Marek Izu of the Hegemony (@arch_izu).

Severin Samhatespeac took the same post at R-F9 where Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac stood. He found his uncle's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them. The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Severin Samhatespeac was number 81. He still remembers how stiff the colonel's glove felt.
A familiar voice came out of the fog in the wrong direction. Severin Samhatespeac waited for the password before answering.
Severin Samhatespeac reached up to fix a sandbag at R-F9 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Felix Zulfi of the Hegemony (@rayan.zulfi).

Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Severin Samhatespeac is whole again, or near enough for the line. Blackwater Canal is lost. Severin Samhatespeac heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Severin Samhatespeac saw Norbert Alexgreve freeze up on the fire step at Blackwater Canal. Severin said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-F9 with the rations. Severin Samhatespeac ate while listening to the revised orders.

A sniper's bullet hit Severin Samhatespeac at R-F9. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Felix Zulfi of the Hegemony (@rayan.zulfi). Severin Samhatespeac was killed on watch at R-F9. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Felix Zulfi of the Hegemony (@rayan.zulfi).
Dietrich Samhatespeac joined R-F9 under the shadow of Severin Samhatespeac's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
Dietrich Samhatespeac had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Bastian Mnp was badly wounded.
Dietrich Samhatespeac began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.

Word of Dietrich Samhatespeac's blanket spread. A strip of lining and a square from an old scarf arrived without explanation. Dietrich Samhatespeac transferred to the sappers. The men in R-F9 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.

At R-F9 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Dietrich Samhatespeac turned around and took a shovel blow. Casimir Jcsv of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Casimir Jcsv of the Hegemony (@jcsv2305). In the dark of the Hegemony trench Dietrich Samhatespeac hit Ivo "Bones" Rylan with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@rylan_45h) Dietrich Samhatespeac has a bed in the hospital dugout at last, between a man who prays and a man who swears. He says it is a fair balance. Dietrich Samhatespeac is out of danger. Still bedridden, still bandaged, but out of danger.

Dietrich Samhatespeac stopped talking around midday. The medic took one look and called for a stretcher. An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Dietrich Samhatespeac was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout. The letter for Dietrich Samhatespeac had a few coins taped inside. They would buy almost nothing here, but Dietrich Samhatespeac kept them.
The field hospital let Dietrich go. He came back up the line on foot because the truck would not wait.
scp_610_a: Pavel Scp arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in R-C10 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

A single shot from across the wire hit Pavel Scp in the thigh at R-C10. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Viktor "Button" Glas of the Concord (@eze.glas). A single shot at R-C10. Pavel Scp sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Viktor "Button" Glas of the Concord (@eze.glas).
The papers connected Otto "Whistle" Scp to Pavel Scp. The men took longer to learn Otto "Whistle" Scp's own habits, but they made the effort.

The cook's fire went out. Otto "Whistle" Scp relit it under his own coat and served stew that tasted of wool. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Otto "Whistle" Scp is number 704. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Otto "Whistle" Scp during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Someone returned an empty pot polished with bread. Otto "Whistle" Scp accepted it as a review.
Otto "Whistle" Scp made soup from what the rats left. The men called it the best soup on the front, and they were not joking.
Otto "Whistle" Scp saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards.
Otto "Whistle" Scp (Hegemony) watched Ulrich "Whistle" Coors (Concord) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at the Hanging Bridge, and held fire until both were gone.
A newspaper reached Otto "Whistle" Scp with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well.
Otto "Whistle" Scp sang under his breath on sentry. Across the wire, very quietly, somebody sang the next line.
Otto helped dig a latrine and later dug a second one in a better spot. The first was relabeled as a storage pit.
sir_chud_is_freaking_it: Bram "Mud" Freaking came up with a draft of replacements on Day 10. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

Bram "Mud" Freaking and Wendel "Crow" Bangnbreach found a cat in the ruins at the Hanging Bridge and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Crow. A letter from home found Bram "Mud" Freaking before the night shift. Bram "Mud" Freaking folded it small and kept it close. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at Q-F3 changed before the cheering ended. Bram "Mud" Freaking shouldered another load. The new duty roster listed Bram "Mud" Freaking as a sapper. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

Bram "Mud" Freaking owes Jakub Faulerhund so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full. A letter from home found Bram "Mud" Freaking before the night shift. Bram "Mud" Freaking folded it small and kept it close.

A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Bram "Mud" Freaking closed his eyes while someone else distributed them. A letter from home found Bram "Mud" Freaking before the night shift. Bram "Mud" Freaking folded it small and kept it close.

Viktor Kizr lent Bram "Mud" Freaking a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg. A letter from home found Bram "Mud" Freaking before the night shift. Bram "Mud" Freaking folded it small and kept it close.

A bullet hit Bram "Mud" Freaking's belt buckle at Q-F3 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Henrik "Ghost" Keithforbes of the Concord (@keithforbes65s).
Bram "Mud" Freaking's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at Q-F3 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.

Bram "Mud" Freaking checked the safety catch three times before handing over the post. The man taking over noticed, and checked it once more. A thin letter reached Bram "Mud" Freaking. Only five lines long, and Bram "Mud" Freaking knew every one of them by heart before supper.
Bram caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either.
valta_zhar: The new rifleman gave his name as Arno Zhar. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
Arno Zhar mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted.

Arno Zhar was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-S15. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Valentin "Spark" Saam of the Hegemony (@saam_1z). The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Arno Zhar watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools. A letter from home reached Arno Zhar before dusk. Arno Zhar read it twice and slept a little easier.

Arno Zhar's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at R-S15 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Arno Zhar is number 540. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Arno Zhar looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-S15 and grazed Arno Zhar's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Severin Vazintian of the Hegemony (@vazintian).
Arno Zhar returned to R-S15 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Arno Zhar tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at R-S15 is up.
Arno Zhar and Bastian Collins argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
The raid was quick, the way back was not. Arno Zhar snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Arno Zhar free.
The wound looked small. It was not. Arno Zhar was carried back with a fever and a hand that would not stop shaking. A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Arno Zhar was carried in at last.
Arno is out of danger. The surgeon will not say it aloud, but he looks pleased.
vazintian: Severin Vazintian arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

Severin Vazintian counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Jakub Wolfmecher was grazed. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Severin Vazintian watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Severin Vazintian had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Felix Wyatt was badly wounded. A letter from home reached Severin Vazintian before dusk. Severin Vazintian read it twice and slept a little easier. Grey Mill has been won. Severin Vazintian listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Severin Vazintian did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Severin Vazintian fired back. Arno Zhar was grazed.
Severin Vazintian of the Hegemony and Jonas Justafungi of the Concord share the same habit: a whistle at midnight. Both lines at Grey Mill now wait for it before they sleep.

Severin Vazintian crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at R-R15 holds again. Severin Vazintian fired at the sound of digging across the wire. The digging stopped. Karel "Button" Nikola was grazed. A bullet clipped Severin Vazintian's helmet at R-R15 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Leopold "Doc" Anjvryss of the Concord (@anjvryss).
Three days with a bandage, and Severin Vazintian is back at R-R15. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
Severin Vazintian went over with the night raiders, found the enemy trench empty at that spot, and came back with a bag of their biscuits.

Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Felix Someonenamed stood up to sing louder, and Severin Vazintian fired. Felix Someonenamed was badly wounded. The singing stopped. Severin Vazintian fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Karel "Button" Nikola, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything.
Severin dragged the gun to a new position at R-R15 before dawn. It weighs a good deal more at four in the morning.
wahoocardboard: Otto Wahoocardboa stepped off the supply cart at Q-F2 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into Q-F2. Otto Wahoocardboa has learned to walk bent double.

The mud froze hard overnight. For one morning Otto Wahoocardboa could walk on top of it, like a man walking on water. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Otto Wahoocardboa stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
The sergeant at Q-F2 called out a range and a spot. Otto Wahoocardboa was the only one who hit it. Teodor "Whistle" Jeanms was gravely wounded.
Leopold "Hollow" Nekroticdeka pulled Otto Wahoocardboa out of a flooded shell hole at the Bone Quarry. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
New laces made Otto Wahoocardboa's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Otto Wahoocardboa was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.
The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At Q-F2 they left Otto Wahoocardboa behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Jonas Breadwards of the Hegemony (@breadwards.7).
The papers say Nils Wahoocardboa. The sergeant says he has his brother's eyes. Otto Wahoocardboa's eyes. Nobody in Q-F2 argues.
Nils Wahoocardboa found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.
A letter reached Nils from Old Harrow. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one.
